candidates.name: Aristotle South Pipeline
candidates.from: Socrates South power plant, New Albany, Licking County OH
candidates.to: Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect, Liberty Township, Fairfield County OH

evidence.note: Notice of filing, OPSB case 25-0561-GA-BLN: about 17.9 miles of 24-inch high-pressure steel pipe from Socrates South to an Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage interconnect (LON filed 23 June 2025)
Socrates South 200 MW behind-the-meter plant, fed by two 24-inch pipelines, serves a Meta-affiliate (Sidecat LLC) data center
Williams project page lists Aristotle South Pipeline, case 25-0561-GA-BLN, under Socrates power solution facilities

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for any Aristotle/Will-Power line (closest by area: none in Ohio/Fairfield County). Length about 17.9 mi (about 28.8 km); data center tie via Meta campus power plant.
